description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and similarity scores for different configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. 

The first line, colored red and solid, begins at approximately 0.07 at Layer 0 and decreases to approximately 0.05 at Layer 2, then increases to a peak of approximately 0.28 at Layer 4, before decreasing to approximately 0.13 at Layer 16, and then sharply increasing to approximately 0.43 at Layer 22. The second line, colored blue and solid, starts at approximately 0.08 at Layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.06 at Layer 2, then increases to a peak of approximately 0.26 at Layer 4, and then gradually decreases to approximately 0.08 at Layer 16, before increasing to approximately 0.23 at Layer 22. The third line, colored green and solid, begins at approximately 0.06 at Layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.04 at Layer 2, increases to approximately 0.14 at Layer 4, and then decreases to approximately 0.06 at Layer 16, before increasing to approximately 0.13 at Layer 22. The fourth line, colored magenta and solid, starts at approximately 0.05 at Layer 0, increases to approximately 0.11 at Layer 2, decreases to approximately 0.08 at Layer 4, and then decreases to approximately 0.05 at Layer 16, before increasing to approximately 0.18 at Layer 22.
